title: impact-scan:v1 structured output block
description: Machine-readable form of the fenced ```impact-scan:v1 code block that skills/pre-implementation-impact-scan/SKILL.md's 'Structured output block (impact-scan:v1)' section (that section is the normative spec; this schema is its machine-readable mirror) requires at the end of an impact-scan report -- exactly one such block per report. Two design principles this schema enforces structurally, both explained in that section: (1) raw observations only, no synthesized aggregate score/rank/priority field -- the scan reports what it found, and leaves 'is this impact large or small' to the downstream consumer; (2) no `digest` field -- a consumer that needs a reproducibility digest computes it itself from candidate_paths+candidate_layers, so a stale or hand-edited digest can never silently pass through this block (see lane's ImpactScanSnapshot: its `digest` field is added AFTER parsing this block, by the consumer, and is never accepted from the block itself).

candidate_paths.description: sol architect-review must7: no duplicates (uniqueItems, schema-enforced) and MUST be sorted ascending (lexicographic; a semantic check in verify-fixtures.mjs, not expressible as a plain schema constraint) -- a producer sorts before emitting so two equivalent scans always produce a byte-identical input to a consumer's own digest computation. Order-of-discovery is not part of this block's contract; the sorted order is.

candidate_layers.description: Same sort/uniqueness rule as candidate_paths, for the same reproducibility reason.
